purpose: Freeze the Stage 12B production decision for the official Russian Government news feed without weakening HTTPS-only factual acquisition.

source.registry_binding: Do not add this source to the live READY registry until a production-reachable HTTPS route is proven. This blocker contract is the canonical TASK4 decision record.
source.available_at_policy: When a secure route is proven, use the timezone-aware RSS pubDate as published_at and available_at; ingestion must not precede acquisition completion.
unblock_conditions: Prove a stable production-reachable HTTPS official Government RSS or equivalent official route.
Validate the final redirect target and allowed host over HTTPS.
Retain bounded timeout and response-size limits.
Retain stable item provenance and timezone-aware publication timestamps.
Do not change classifier, dedupe, clustering, or directional/action authority semantics.
